dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.defect: rerank ranked same-entity sibling chunks by BM25 document length instead of question coverage
dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.root_cause: BM25 length normalization penalizes directive-appended chunks; attribute chunks share entity tokens
dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.fix: coverage-primary rerank (COVERAGE_WEIGHT 1.0, BM25 tie-break 0.01), preregistered before FINAL

dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.defect: multi-hop bridge missed 'writer'/'person who wrote' phrasings
dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.root_cause: bridge looked only at the top-ranked item
dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.fix: bridge scans rank order for a creator-attribute item gated by birth+creator cues

dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.defect: nonexistent-person queries matched a real person's chunks sharing only the surname
dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.root_cause: entity gate skipped the sentence-initial token, so the first given name was never verified
dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.fix: entity gate checks all capitalized non-framing tokens

dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.defect: TCP layer question abstained at the coverage gate
dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.root_cause: question template used 'operate' while the chunk text carried 'operates'
dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.fix: benchmark phrasings use the chunk's attribute verb (pre-FINAL); question templates keep the coverage-safety constraint

dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.defect: historical 'as of <year>' questions abstained at the coverage gate (found by the T21.56 smoke)
dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.root_cause: the as-of temporal frame contributes tokens no snapshot chunk can contain; the temporal floor metrics never measured as-of answer correctness so the eval did not surface it
dev_tuning_defects_resolved_before_freez.fix: for as-of-classified queries the coverage gate measures content only (as-of phrase and question-function words are framing); the full eval was re-recorded on the unchanged frozen suites
